title: Odd symmetrization identity
statement: Let $C$ be a sign query check and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube. Averaging the randomized value of $C$ over all independent choices to negate its queries equals the randomized value of $C$ on the odd part of $f$, the function $x\mapsto (f(x)-f(-x))/2$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
